upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact commit. Moving main cannot inherit qualification.

materialChanges: Adds provider credential-reference registration and Workbench management without accepting or storing provider key values in the application contract.
Adds inference source and binding registries, explicit review/approval request contracts, provider-secret adapters, and dispatch/restart grant rechecks.
Registered credential selection denies legacy Hugging Face fallback; recipe/model/connection/registry or presence changes invalidate review.
Writes use expected-revision conflict control, but upstream explicitly supports one controller write authority and does not provide distributed CAS or locking.
Declared allowed hosts are review metadata rather than firewall enforcement, so network egress policy must remain independently enforced by SZL controls.
Disabling a credential reference denies new admission/restart but does not remotely revoke already-running workers.

acceptance: Use synthetic secret names and mock presence only; no real credential value may enter source, fixtures, logs, receipts, prompts or benchmark output.
Prove reference-only storage and reject any key-value persistence or disclosure path.
Prove recipe, model, connection, registry and credential-presence changes invalidate prior review and confirmation.
Prove expected-revision conflicts fail closed and uncertain network-save outcomes require readback rather than blind retry.
Prove selected registered references never fall back to legacy Hugging Face credentials when missing, disabled or unauthorized.
Prove dispatch and restart recheck the same exact grant and reviewed binding.
Treat declared hosts as non-enforcing metadata and require an independent egress allowlist/firewall witness before any provider call is eligible.
Exercise the single-writer invariant; multiple concurrent controller authorities are unsupported and must fail the SZL qualification gate.
Keep native key-only/null-URL bindings distinct from chat-completions/responses bindings that require an explicitly reviewed non-null base URL and model_base_url.
Record already-running-worker revocation as unsupported and require a separate termination/rotation control before production consideration.

deduplication.result: material successor observation; preserves prior reproducibility evidence while refreshing the exact source for credential-reference evaluation

alignment.claimBoundary: Secret-reference and inference-binding mechanics are evaluation inputs only. No provider credential, provider route, worker launch, deployment, model qualification or production authority is granted.
